parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: GroupUser
parameters.description: The database account with which the resource group is associated.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb unbind-db-resource-group-with-user --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --group-name test --group-user accout --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-t72410000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb UnbindDBResourceGroupWithUser --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test --GroupUser accout --DBClusterId 'am-bp1ub9grke10000' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-t72410000'
